verdict.rationale: The only evidence of Next.js's own edge capability is a community note that it has an 'edge vs. node' runtime layer, and community comments suggest deployment is easy only on Vercel. First-party deployment docs cover only a Node.js server, Docker, or static export, and running elsewhere needed third-party tooling (OpenNext on Cloudflare). missing for 10: first-party docs on serverless/edge runtime deployment, evidence of zero-config deployment to serverless/edge targets beyond Vercel, hands-on corroboration of a setup-free edge deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom infrastructure setup

citations.quote: Next.js stacks browser, middleware, edge vs. node, and SSR layers
Others say Next makes everything hard except deploying to Vercel
